confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 peak season, with no live listing checks. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is most uncertain because summer demand and cruise-season pricing swing widely. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine glass about 1.25x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 0.7002 value was read from an RBA homepage snapshot stamped 4.00 pm 14 October 2026, but the snapshot layout was jumbled and the label-to-number pairing was not fully verified against the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the Adriatic coastal tourism cluster (Budva, Herceg Novi, and lower-cost Dalmatian towns), adjusted for Montenegro's somewhat lower cost base relative to Dubrovnik. Prices are in euro-denominated terms and converted to USD by the model's general knowledge, not from a live rate.
